params.message:
The source scorecard reads what insights name once

The scorecard counted a source's cited signals with a test per signal over every current
insight and its signal list. On 23 November 2026, with 11,134 insights and 146 sources on
trial, one source of 1,166 signals took longer than a minute. The morning desk mail asks the
scorecard for every source on trial when the server starts and on its first round after
07:00 UTC, on the server's only thread, so the Observatory answered nothing from that morning
until the mail was held by hand. Ask builds the same list for every question.

The signals a current insight names are now read once per call, and each source's signals
are counted against that set.

Portal: De Observatory van Gentells blijft weer bereikbaar wanneer de ochtendmail van de redactie vertrekt.
